name: skupper-confined-filesystem-event-admission-1358
instr:
Skupper cannot confine non-Kubernetes filesystem processing to verified objects beneath each namespace's trusted roots or report rejected changes locally. Preserve ordinary discovery, reconciliation, status, namespace lifecycle, and router activation for legitimate objects.

Make `NewWatcher` in `github.com/skupperproject/skupper/internal/filesystem` admit identity-stable `ChangeEvent` values before `FileWatcher` dispatch or `FileWatcher.Resync`. Rejected or stale objects must not reach `FSChangeHandler.HandleFSChange` side effects. `AdmissionPolicy.Admit` rejects escaping paths. `ChangeEvent.Validate` reports replacements through `AdmissionError` and `ChangeResult` as `ChangeRejected` or `ChangeStale`; accepted work uses `ChangeAccepted`.

Keep `NewInputResourceHandler`, `NewNamespacesHandler`, `NewNetworkStatusHandler`, and `NewRouterConfigHandler` in `github.com/skupperproject/skupper/internal/nonkube/controller` unchanged for admitted regular resources, real directories, ConfigMaps, and router configurations. Rejection must not change prior runtime SiteState or trigger controller or activation callbacks.

`NewQuarantineStore`, `QuarantineStore.Record`, and `QuarantineStore.List` preserve every `QuarantineRecord`, including repeats, in insertion order. Namespace-isolated reports contain deterministic relative input, operation, handler, reason, stable identity, and object type.
